How every planner works

Same simple flow in all three — because your picks go to a real person at Sharma, not a checkout cart.

1
You pick

Choose a package, add the products and extras you want, and tell us about your home. It takes a few minutes on your phone.

2
Sharma reviews it

Your list goes to office@sharmaelectric.com. Sharma checks sizing, compatibility and what your home actually needs.

3
One priced quote

You get one clear price for the whole job before any work starts — and a call back to walk through it.
